title: Folk culture of Andhra: more works and detail

boxes.title: People & periods: more
items: Burrakatha popularisers: Nazar, **Nittala Brothers**, **Bhadrakali**; researcher **Dr. Tangirala Subbarao**
Adibhatla: multilingual; also wrote Satakams (Rama, Mukunda, Shiva, Mrutyunjaya)
Eastern Chalukyas: also **Purana Kalakshepams**; Manasollasa = **Abhilashitartha Chintamani**
Late Vijayanagara: **Vachana** (prose-drama) style; **Vipra-Vinodins** acted for Brahmins

boxes.title: Harikatha & Burrakatha: more
items: Harikatha: about **3 hours**; fuses music, story, dance, philosophy, literature
Burrakatha also **Jamukula Kathalu**; instrument **Ukki**; heroic + tragic rasas
==Carried news, reform, nationalist messages to villages==
Ballads on **Bobbili War** (**1757**): **Vijayarama Raju** took **French** help (Bussy)

boxes.title: Kathas: format
head: Form
Format
rows: Bells (**Jeganta**); dance round pillar with Sita-Rama-Lakshmana idols

boxes.title: Puppetry, Surabhi, today
items: Shadow puppetry also in **Odisha, Kerala, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu**
Surabhi: born at a ==**wedding** in Sorugu==; family theatre about **140 years** old
AP **Ugadi** and **Kalaratna** awards include Harikatha, Burrakatha artists (**19 Mar 2026**)
Nandi revival announced at **Undavalli Caves**; **Telugu Mahotsavam** also revives **Padya Natakam**
Decline: only **3-4** shows a year; Centre's ==**Kala Sanskriti Vikas Yojana**==
